steps.step: RWC1.folded debug cells: with the BDT walk det(1 + B) is real on the 4-site (walk vanishes) and 8-site cells (round-off) -- a geometric artefact; with the frozen h_W the 4-site cell conserves n.sigma and has the exact number-conserving special formula (PF2): a sign-validation cell, not a phase-severity cell

RWC2.the 16-site cubic cell carries genuine phases for the frozen Theta_1 kinetics h_W: the stabilised phase of det(1 + B) is far above round-off and is reproduced by an independent split factorisation

RWC3.phase-quenched sampling (phase tracked along the chain) on the 16- and 32-site cells, frozen Theta_1 (md) and, separately, the BDT diagnostic: R, -log R, Var theta, Delta f = -log R/(beta V), cost factor 1/R^2, autocorrelation, acceptance, zero detector
RWC4.Trotter control for Theta_1 at beta = 1, g = 0.1 (16 sites): dtau = 0.25 and 0.125 give the same average phase within 3 sigma or 1 %

RWC5.volume scaling at fixed beta v / L (Theta_1): Delta f on 16 and 32 sites for the same g and c_beta; the larger extrapolates (R ~ exp(-Delta f beta V)) to the 128-site cell (estimate only -- 16 and 32 are not a homothetic family); BDT diagnostic alongside

RWC6.(statement) Go / No-Go for Theta_1: N_eff ~ N_samples R^2; R >= 0.1 on the relevant cells -> physics measurement; R << 1e-2 with stable Delta f > 0 -> tensor networks; the thermodynamic mirror gap is not yet measured
steps.detail: reweighting of Theta_1 feasible (lowest R = 0.3057, extrapolated R_128 ~ 9.13e-01): go to the g phase map and the mirror-gap measurement; Gate B stays open

steps.step: RWC7.Trotter scaling of the Theta_1 phase (16 sites, beta = 1, g = 0.1): -log R falls from dtau = 0.25 to 0.125 and is converged between 0.125 and 0.0625 -> a genuine, small continuum-time phase; dtau = 0.25 overestimates it

RWC9.(finding) Trotter dependence of the Theta_1 phase at strong coupling on 32 sites (beta = 2.5, g = 0.1): unlike the 16-site, beta = 1 case, -log R GROWS when dtau is halved -- the dtau = 0.25 phases underestimate the sign problem at strong coupling; the 'mild phase' statement is restricted to coarse dtau / weak coupling until dtau -> 0 is controlled (20 sweeps, large error)

RWC10.(finding) volume growth of the Theta_1 phase at fixed c_beta = 0.5, g = 0.1, dtau = 0.25 (16 / 32 / 64 sites, NOT a homothetic family): -log R grows much faster than beta V, i.e. Delta f = -log R / (beta V) is not yet intensive and increases with V; together with RWC9 (dtau = 0.25 underestimates the phase at strong coupling) reweighting at g = 0.1 is feasible to ~64-128 sites at most

RWC8.(statement) first mirror-node measurement for Theta_1 on 16 sites (reweighted G_P(tau), Gamma exactly free, order-parameter susceptibility, composite seeds): small-volume indication only, no thermodynamic gap statement
